name: FunctionQA
intro: FunctionQA 是 MathVista 新建的 400 题视觉代数子集，要求模型精细感知函数图并对变量、表达式、方程和函数进行代数推理。题目由 STEM 研究生人工标注，经三位评审独立核验和共识修订，再按 MathVista 的答案抽取、归一化与精确准确率协议评测。
org: UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research
build_method: STEM 研究生人工标注, 三人独立复核, 共识消歧
task_type: 函数图问答, 视觉代数推理
eval_feature: 函数图精细感知, 代数推理, 确定性答案归一化
build_method_en: STEM graduate-student annotation, three independent reviews, consensus resolution
eval_feature_en: Fine-grained Function-plot Perception, Algebraic Reasoning, Deterministic Answer Normalization
intro_en: FunctionQA is MathVista's newly created 400-example visual-algebra subset. It requires fine-grained perception of function plots and algebraic reasoning over variables, expressions, equations, and functions. STEM graduate students manually annotate items, three reviewers independently verify them, and MathVista extracts, normalizes, and exactly scores model answers.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the FunctionQA portions of arXiv:2310.02255 Sections 2.2–2.4 and 3.1. FunctionQA is a MathVista-created visual algebra subset, not an Intern-S1 benchmark about software functions or tools. Its 400 items emphasize subtle perception of function plots and algebra over variables, expressions, equations, and functions. STEM graduate students manually annotate the new datasets; three reviewers independently check them, yielding 99.2% agreement across 736 new MathVista items, and the six disagreements are resolved by consensus. FunctionQA is standardized as math-targeted textbook QA with function-plot context and algebraic skill. Evaluation generates a response from image and query, uses a GPT-4 short-answer extractor, normalizes the answer, and computes deterministic exact accuracy.
